intended_object: A ring isomorphism `ULift.{u} ℤ_[p] ≃+* ULift.{v} ℤ_[p]` that changes only the universe level of the lift. The docstring and name say this. It is universe bookkeeping for transporting p-adic factors.
explanation: The definition composes `ULift.ringEquiv` with its inverse to move between two universe liftings of ℤ_p. Mathematically both sides are just ℤ_p, and the map is the identity. It exists only to deal with Lean's universe levels. It has no counterpart in the literature, so it is an implementation detail rather than a mathematical object.
